name: Request Remote Work Day
goal: Employee requests a single remote work day and receives confirmation.
constraints: Date must be in the future and not a weekend.

phases.description: User asks to work remotely on a specific date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the request and asks for the date.

phases.description: User provides a valid future weekday date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the date is valid and submits the request.

phases.description: Bot confirms the remote work day is approved.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message includes approval and the correct date.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
